name: DEHYDRATED ALCOHOL
indications_original: Dehydrated alcohol injection is indicated to induce controlled cardiac septal infarction to improve exercise capacity in adults with symptomatic hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy who are not candidates for surgical myectomy.
contraindications_original: • Inject small volumes over 1 to 2 minutes percutaneously into septal arterial branches, using the minimal dose necessary to achieve the desired reduction in peak left ventricular outflow tract pressure gradient. (2.1) • In most situations, a dose of 1 mL to 2 mL is sufficient. The maximum dose that should be used in a single procedure is 5 mL. (2.1)
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Dehydrated alcohol injection, USP is a clear, colorless liquid supplied in clear, glass, single-dose vials. Each mL contains ≥ 99% by volume ethyl alcohol.
